windows_compatibility_fixes.change: Added Windows-only fsync shim; ignores EPERM/EINVAL for read-only file and directory handles, rethrows everything else.
windows_compatibility_fixes.reason: Local store fsyncs a read-only temp handle and the store directory; both return EPERM on Windows.

windows_compatibility_fixes.change: Imports the fsync compatibility shim before application modules load.
windows_compatibility_fixes.reason: Applies the shim to every seed/render/scan/smoke/test entry point.

windows_compatibility_fixes.change: Recognizes Windows drive paths (D:\ or D:/) as local files before URL-scheme detection.
windows_compatibility_fixes.reason: D: was parsed as a URL scheme, so local material paths fell through to fetch and hit interview_external_network_blocked.
